name: SwordWeave
creator: Marius Ion (Mashu)
oneLine: SwordWeave is a free modular tabletop roleplaying game with browser tools for building characters and abilities from shared rules.
shortDescription: SwordWeave is a free modular tabletop RPG by Marius Ion (Mashu). Players build characters and abilities from shared rules, then agree intent, scope, costs and consequences with their table. The v0.1 alpha includes public rules, browser tools and an illustrated Player’s Handbook; the GM Guide and SRD are still being revised.
longDescription: SwordWeave is a free modular tabletop roleplaying game and a set of browser tools by Marius Ion (Mashu). Characters, effects and capabilities draw on a shared vocabulary of primitives. The same owned ingredients can support several actions: players and the GM agree what is being attempted, which permissions apply, and the costs and consequences in the scene. Public rules and books can be read without an account; an account is used to save work in the browser tools. The illustrated Player’s Handbook is complete for the current v0.1 alpha. The Game Master’s Guide and System Reference Document remain in revision, and current online readers can differ from downloadable PDF editions. This is a one-person project in active development. Questions, independent assessments and feedback from actual sessions are welcome.

limitations: The rules and tools are evolving. Alpha availability is not evidence of independent playtest results or comparative balance.
Some Library content is provisional. The founder is still gathering feedback from play.
The PHB, GM Guide and SRD are not yet a synchronized final set. Check the book and edition before quoting a rule.
There is no claim of compatibility with another game’s rules or character builders.
aiDisclosure: AI was used in creating the SwordWeave platform, books and artwork. The system design and the platform’s UI and UX are Marius Ion’s own. AI assisted implementation and book production, including reasoning through programming problems.

For the book illustrations and heritage artwork, AI took the lead in art direction as well as generating the images. Illustrations were made with OpenAI image-generation tools under Marius Ion’s direction.
SwordWeave is currently a one-person project. The Player’s Handbook contains the creator’s fuller note, “AI and this alpha.”
